claims.text: On the driver's own trace, his stationary in-geofence dwell at the pickup pin is 195 seconds. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec as POL-NS-01(c) directs and not the 180-second default. The shortfall is 105 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable on that shortfall alone - whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to any message - so the $4.00 charged must be refunded in full.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and limb (c) is broken. Limb (c) demands that the driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force; the measured run is 195 seconds against the 300 seconds carried by trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec for this STANDARD pickup. The rider wins by breaking a single limb, and the break is on the driver's own telemetry, not on any inference.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails independently. It requires the termination to fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20, the 300-second period would have run out at about 19:46:20; the driver cancelled at 19:44:40, roughly 100 seconds early, and stamped the trip RIDER_NO_SHOW. A rider cannot be recorded as a no-show at a moment when the waiting period she paid for had not yet expired; the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is mis-selected and the fee is not chargeable on limb (d) either.

The shortfall cannot be cured by accumulation under POL-NS-06(i). The trace shows a single in-geofence interval - run_count 1, the run from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 - so there is no second interval to add. And limb (i) is unavailable on its own terms: EV-ADVIS-00203-01, the traffic advisory, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, so no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory can be asserted to extend the clock. Even doubling 195 seconds would not reach the 300-second minimum.

The rider was not an absent rider. Her own device track carries 60 qualifying fixes placing her between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pickup pin - inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius - continuously across the waiting window, and she messaged the driver at 19:42:50 to say she was coming down. Any reading of the record as a rider who failed to appear is contradicted by the rider's track; the charge fails on the driver's clock in any event. For transparency: EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (MSG-00203-002 is contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'); I do not rest the refund on it, and the presence figures come from EV-GPS-00203, which the pre-pass assessed COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

No driver compensation can be paid on this record, and the refund is the whole contested sum. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not; POL-NS-06 states that where cumulative dwell falls short of the minimum the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. The ledger confirms the fee_charged of 4.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on a FULL_REFUND the rider recovers the entire $4.00 and nothing is left standing against her.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged, so this should be decided on the arithmetic rather than sent to human review. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 limb (d) requires; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) cannot fire; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 - below the 4 of the first limb - and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 131 is 0.015, below the 0.08 second limb, so both limbs fail and no compensation is withheld on that ground either. The deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, above the 0.70 floor of POL-GEN-02 and POL-NS-09(a).

The one impaired artifact in the bundle does not cap confidence or force escalation. EV-CHAT-00203 sits at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, and that impairment is schema-level only: it meets no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08. There is no clock-skew tag on either EV-TRIP-00203 or EV-GPS-00203 (both COMPLETE, no issues); the trace reports gaps of [] and max_gap_sec 0.0 with 60 fixes across the window, so there is no gap over 120 seconds; the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3; and the 4.00 cancellation line reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is satisfied. Under POL-GEN-02 the chat is down-weighted in confidence when used, and I have not used it as the ground of the refund; it does not engage POL-NS-09(e).

The driver physically reached the pickup point. EV-GPS-00203 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with 21 qualifying fixes at 5-11 m accuracy - well inside the 25 m filter POL-NS-02 applies - the first at 19:41:20, fifteen seconds before the 'arrived' event recorded at 19:41:35 in EV-TRIP-00203. Arrival under POL-NS-02 is established and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied: this was a real drive to the pin, not a remote arrival tap.

POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the arrival marker the driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) and inside the arrival radius, 18.7-50 m from the pin, nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger or the 15 km/h motion trigger, so the marker is not a false-arrival event, the waiting clock is not recalibrated, and no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) may be recorded against the driver.

The termination satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (d) on its own terms: EV-TRIP-00203 records the trip as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb recognises, and there is no boarding event. The driver did not record DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, so the limb-(d) driver-education referral for a mis-selected reason code does not arise.

POL-NS-04 cannot be run against the driver, so this cannot be turned into a driver-side coordination failure: the driver posted his reply at 19:44:31, 101 seconds after the rider's message at 19:42:50 and therefore inside the 120-second window in limb (b). EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight 0.85 for LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY on MSG-00203-002 and I disclose that; this claim rests only on message timestamps, which that ambiguity does not affect.

I do not argue the fee above the record. The driver's continuous in-geofence hold was 195 seconds (19:41:20 to 19:44:35), 105 seconds short of the 300-second free waiting period in force on this trip from platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot make up the difference because the trace contains a single in-geofence interval and the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00203-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0. On the strict-liability terms of POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full POL-NS-07 gives the driver no compensation: the driver's claim to the $4.00 cannot be sustained on this evidence.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider. No compensation is payable to the driver. The fee stands or falls on the waiting clock, and the clock does not reach the required period.

THE FIGURES. The driver's own trace (EV-GPS-00203, weight 1.0, unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, 60 fixes) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20 and stationary at the pin until 19:44:35 — a single continuous in-geofence dwell of 195 seconds, with no second interval and no sampling gap (max_gap_sec 0.0). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec in EV-TRIP-00203 (weight 1.0), exactly as POL-NS-01(c) directs and not the 180-second default. The shortfall is 105 seconds. The driver cancelled at 19:44:40 and stamped the trip RIDER_NO_SHOW. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable on that shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied; the waiting period is the consideration she paid the fee for. POL-NS-01(c) is therefore broken and limb (d) fails independently, because limb (d) requires the termination to fall at or after the required dwell elapsed: 300 seconds from 19:41:20 would run out about 19:46:20, and the driver cancelled roughly 100 seconds early.

THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS. The driver is right that he genuinely arrived (POL-NS-02: 21 qualifying fixes at 5–11 m accuracy, inside the 25 m filter, the first at 19:41:20 before the 19:41:35 'arrived' event), that POL-NS-05 does not bite (at the marker he was stationary and inside the radius, so the marker is not false and no false-arrival referral arises), and that POL-NS-04 does not apply (his reply at 19:44:31 came 101 seconds after the rider's 19:42:50 message, inside limb (b)'s 120-second window). All three are accepted, but none of them saves the fee: arrival under POL-NS-01(b) is satisfied while limb (c) is not. His claim that limb (d) is satisfied 'on its own terms' is rejected: limb (d) needs both a recognised reason code — which RIDER_NO_SHOW is — and a termination at or after the required dwell elapsed, and the timing element fails. The referee's discard of the driver's second shortfall argument (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED on EV-ADVIS-00203-01) is recorded below; the point it makes is in any event established by the surviving claims.

ACCUMULATION. POL-NS-06(i) cannot cure the shortfall. The trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00203-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory exists to permit summing. Even so, doubling 195 seconds would not reach 300.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, and that clause states expressly that where cumulative dwell falls short, the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. EV-FARE-00203 confirms the $4.00 was CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the entire $4.00 returns to the rider and nothing is left standing against her.

IMPAIRED ARTIFACT NARRATION. EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.85 for issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (MSG-00203-002, 'wait ah, i coming liao', contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'). That is schema-level only: it meets no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08, the log holds 3 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and no court of this case rests on it — the deciding fact, the 195-second dwell, is carried by EV-GPS-00203 alone and the 300-second figure by EV-TRIP-00203, both at weight 1.0. Confidence is therefore capped at 1.0 and is well above the 0.70 floor.

ESCALATION AND REFERRALS. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: there is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 (limb (c)); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 limb (d) requires; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2/131 = 0.015, below 0.08). No clause produces a referral, so the list is empty. The monetary effect, $4.00, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so the refund executes automatically. This ruling was made without human review and is provisional; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: the disputed $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. The charge does not stand.

What happened. EV-TRIP-00203 records the driver arriving at 19:41:35 and cancelling the trip at 19:44:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. EV-GPS-00203, an unbroken 10-second trace (60 fixes, gaps [] with max gap 0.0 s), places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the pickup pin from 19:41:20, with 21 qualifying fixes. His continuous in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds (19:41:20 to 19:44:35).

Why the fee fails. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from EV-TRIP-00203's platform_policy.free_wait_sec as POL-NS-01(c) directs, not the 180-second default. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee does not stand, and the full $4.00 is refunded to the rider.

Why: the fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for the whole free waiting period in force. On this trip that period is 300 seconds — read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (EV-TRIP-00203, weight 1.0), not the 180-second default. The driver's own trace (EV-GPS-00203, weight 1.0) shows one continuous stationary hold inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35: 195 seconds. The shortfall is 105 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 a shortfall makes the fee non-chargeable and it is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied. POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails for the same reason, and limb (d) fails independently: the 300-second wait would have run out at about 19:46:20, but the trip was cancelled at 19:44:40. The driver's RIDER_NO_SHOW code is one limb (d) recognises, but a no-show cannot be stamped before the waiting period has elapsed — so that part of the driver's case is rejected on the timing, not on the code. The shortfall cannot be cured under POL-NS-06(i): the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to add, and the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00203-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), which makes limb (i) unavailable on its own terms.

The driver did genuinely arrive — 21 qualifying fixes at 5–11 m accuracy, the first at 19:41:20, with the BUTTON arrival marker at 19:41:35 not false — so POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 are satisfied and no false-arrival referral is recorded. But arrival alone does not make the fee chargeable when the waiting period was not served.

No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not, and POL-NS-06 itself says the full refund stands with no compensation where the dwell falls short. The anti-farming check does not trip either (no_show_terminations_30d 2, below 4; 2 ÷ 131 = 0.015, below 0.08).

Nothing here escalates. The deciding facts — the 195-second dwell and the 300-second period in force — rest on EV-GPS-00203 and EV-TRIP-00203 at weight 1.0, so POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (POL-NS-09(b)); there are no same-party repeat disputes (0 and 0, POL-NS-09(c)); and no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3 (POL-NS-09(d)). EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.85 for LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY and I name it as POL-GEN-02(3) requires, but this decision does not rest on it — the shortfall is arithmetic on the driver's own trace and survives the discount. The rider's own track places her 36.4–51.6 m from the pin (inside the 100 m STANDARD radius) and she messaged at 19:42:50; the driver replied at 19:44:31, inside the 120-second window, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her on that path — but none of that decides the case, which turns on the waiting period alone.

The $4.00 monetary effect is below the POL-GEN-05 threshold of $8.00, so the refund executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: On the driver's own trace, his stationary in-geofence dwell at the pickup pin is 195 seconds. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec as POL-NS-01(c) directs and not the 180-second default. The shortfall is 105 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable on that shortfall alone - whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to any message - so the $4.00 charged must be refunded in full.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and limb (c) is broken. Limb (c) demands that the driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force; the measured run is 195 seconds against the 300 seconds carried by trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec for this STANDARD pickup. The rider wins by breaking a single limb, and the break is on the driver's own telemetry, not on any inference.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails independently. It requires the termination to fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20, the 300-second period would have run out at about 19:46:20; the driver cancelled at 19:44:40, roughly 100 seconds early, and stamped the trip RIDER_NO_SHOW. A rider cannot be recorded as a no-show at a moment when the waiting period she paid for had not yet expired; the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is mis-selected and the fee is not chargeable on limb (d) either.

The shortfall cannot be cured by accumulation under POL-NS-06(i). The trace shows a single in-geofence interval - run_count 1, the run from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 - so there is no second interval to add. And limb (i) is unavailable on its own terms: EV-ADVIS-00203-01, the traffic advisory, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, so no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory can be asserted to extend the clock. Even doubling 195 seconds would not reach the 300-second minimum.

The rider was not an absent rider. Her own device track carries 60 qualifying fixes placing her between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pickup pin - inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius - continuously across the waiting window, and she messaged the driver at 19:42:50 to say she was coming down. Any reading of the record as a rider who failed to appear is contradicted by the rider's track; the charge fails on the driver's clock in any event. For transparency: EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (MSG-00203-002 is contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'); I do not rest the refund on it, and the presence figures come from EV-GPS-00203, which the pre-pass assessed COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

No driver compensation can be paid on this record, and the refund is the whole contested sum. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not; POL-NS-06 states that where cumulative dwell falls short of the minimum the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. The ledger confirms the fee_charged of 4.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on a FULL_REFUND the rider recovers the entire $4.00 and nothing is left standing against her.

The deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, above the 0.70 floor of POL-GEN-02 and POL-NS-09(a).

The one impaired artifact in the bundle does not cap confidence or force escalation. EV-CHAT-00203 sits at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, and that impairment is schema-level only: it meets no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08. There is no clock-skew tag on either EV-TRIP-00203 or EV-GPS-00203 (both COMPLETE, no issues); the trace reports gaps of [] and max_gap_sec 0.0 with 60 fixes across the window, so there is no gap over 120 seconds; the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3; and the 4.00 cancellation line reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is satisfied. Under POL-GEN-02 the chat is down-weighted in confidence when used, and I have not used it as the ground of the refund; it does not engage POL-NS-09(e).

The driver physically reached the pickup point. EV-GPS-00203 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with 21 qualifying fixes at 5-11 m accuracy - well inside the 25 m filter POL-NS-02 applies - the first at 19:41:20, fifteen seconds before the 'arrived' event recorded at 19:41:35 in EV-TRIP-00203. Arrival under POL-NS-02 is established and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied: this was a real drive to the pin, not a remote arrival tap.

POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the arrival marker the driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) and inside the arrival radius, 18.7-50 m from the pin, nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger or the 15 km/h motion trigger, so the marker is not a false-arrival event, the waiting clock is not recalibrated, and no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) may be recorded against the driver.

The termination satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (d) on its own terms: EV-TRIP-00203 records the trip as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb recognises, and there is no boarding event. The driver did not record DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, so the limb-(d) driver-education referral for a mis-selected reason code does not arise.

POL-NS-04 cannot be run against the driver, so this cannot be turned into a driver-side coordination failure: the driver posted his reply at 19:44:31, 101 seconds after the rider's message at 19:42:50 and therefore inside the 120-second window in limb (b).
